visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An extreme close-up focuses on a hot black griddle where fresh oysters and green sprouts are being fried. An orange liquid batter is poured over them from a container, and a fresh egg is cracked directly onto the center. The scene is brightly lit from above, emphasizing the steam and sizzling textures of the food. (2) On a bustling outdoor street with Traditional Chinese signage, two older Caucasian men stand talking. One man wears dark sunglasses and a grey Puma hoodie with arms crossed, while the other wears glasses and has a grey mustache. The sunlight creates a lens flare, and several passers-by in masks are visible in the background. (3) The camera focuses on the cooking process again. A cook wearing purple gloves uses a wide metal spatula to skillfully flip the thinning oyster pancake. The griddle surface is oily and reflective under the bright afternoon light. Background shows colorful containers and various kitchen equipment. (4) A young Caucasian man with short hair and a backpack speaks directly to the camera while walking. He wears a dark shirt with a small white logo. The background is a vibrant, crowded market street in Lukang, filled with yellow awnings and various food stall signs. (5) A metal basket filled with raw, grey-white oysters is shown in detail. Then, a pink plastic ladle pours a white starch mixture onto the hot griddle. Bubbles form in the oil as the batter hits the heat. The lighting is natural and high-contrast. (6) Inside a brightly lit restaurant with white tiled walls and red festive decorations, a cat-faced delivery robot approaches a table. One of the older men, wearing a grey zip-up, reaches out to take a small white container of food from the robot's tray. (7) The three men sit around a wooden table. They use white plastic spoons to scoop portions of the oyster pancake, which is covered in a reddish sauce and topped with onions and greens. They are seen eating and reacting with focused facial expressions. (8) Close-up shots of the food container being emptied. A pair of hands holding a spoon scrapes the last bits of egg and oyster. A small pink bowl of red dipping sauce sits on the table. The man with the mustache is seen licking his fingers. (9) A man and a woman, both wearing sunglasses, ride a four-wheeled yellow pedal surrey on a paved road. The woman is in a blue jacket, the man in grey. They look happy and are talking while pedaling. Urban buildings and parked cars are seen in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the sharp, rhythmic sizzling of food on a hot grill, creating a textured sound bed. A high-tempo acoustic pop BGM with a clear drum beat and bright guitar strumming starts immediately. The narrator's voice is high-arousal, clear, and professional, welcoming the audience. (2) As the scene shifts to the street, a whoosh SFX marks the transition. The narrator’s voice continues at a moderate pace with dynamic pitch contours. We hear the low-level murmur of a crowd and distant city traffic, providing a sense of place. (3) Sizzling sounds return, layered with a metallic clink as a spatula hits the griddle. The narrator's speech rate increases slightly as he describes the food, maintaining a humorous and friendly tone that aligns with the upbeat music. (4) A digital chime or bell SFX sounds as the robot arrives. The audio mix includes the clatter of plastic spoons against bowls and the rustle of food containers. Laughter and several wow exclamations from the men are clearly audible over the music. (5) The group performs a synchronized vocal countdown One, two, three with high intensity and positive valence. This is followed by chewing sounds and satisfied hums. The music remains a constant, energetic presence throughout the dialogue. (6) A burst of recorded applause SFX is used to emphasize the group finishing their meal. The narrator's voice remains dominant, exhibiting high confidence and authority as he explains the Lukang specialty. (7) In the final segment, the sound of natural wind bursts becomes audible as the scene transitions to the outdoors. The older man's voice is heard talking about his past experiences, with a calm and nostalgic tone, while the BGM slowly fades out.
